record.NAME: k_ltb_zone_length
record.DESCRIPTION: Sets the length of the zone.

record.NAME: k_ltb_zone_width
record.DESCRIPTION: Sets the width of the zone.

record.NAME: k_ltb_ego_acceleration_weight
record.DESCRIPTION: This weight factor controls the influence of the positive acceleration value on the predicted velocity in each prediction step.

record.NAME: k_ltb_ego_shape_gain_fixed
record.DESCRIPTION: LTB grows or shrinks the ego shape by multiplying the specified value with the ego dimensions once at the beginning of the prediction phase. Value greater than 1: ego shape will be increased, value lower than 1: ego shape will be decreased

record.NAME: k_ltb_ego_circle_offset
record.DESCRIPTION: This weight factor adds an additional offset to the host circles.

record.NAME: k_ltb_ego_circle_host_length_factor
record.DESCRIPTION: This weight factor controls the influence of the host vehicle length when calculating the host vehicle circle offsets.

record.NAME: k_ltb_ego_deceleration_weight
record.DESCRIPTION: This weight factor controls the influence of the negative acceleration / deceleration value on the predicted velocity in each prediction step.

record.NAME: k_ltb_ego_pred_const_velocity_pred_steps_min
record.DESCRIPTION: This value indicates at which prediction step to switch to a consltbnt velocity prediction model when LTB alert level 4 was active in previous cycle.

record.NAME: k_ltb_ego_max_pred_yaw_angle
record.DESCRIPTION: LTB only continues the ego trajectory calculation if the (absolute) predicted yaw angle to the last straight section is below this threshold.

record.NAME: k_ltb_ego_yawangle_integration_yawrate_min
record.DESCRIPTION: This value indicates the minimum (absolute) yawrate value to start integrating the ego yawangle. Below this threshold the yawangle resets.

record.NAME: k_ltb_ego_shape_gain_per_pred_step
record.DESCRIPTION: LTB grows or shrinks an object's shape by multiplying the specified value with the object's dimensions at every prediction step. This means, the more in the future a prediction step is, the more the shape will be grown or shrunk. This is in addition to the fixed gain specified by k_ego_shape_gain_fixed. Value greater than 1: ego shape will grow, value lower than 1: ego shape will shrink

record.NAME: k_ltb_prediction_steps_max
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of steps to predict trajectories of the ego and the relevant objects.

record.NAME: k_ltb_obj_pred_speed_min
record.DESCRIPTION: LTB only continues object trajectory calculation if the predicted waypoint speed is equal or above this threshold.

record.NAME: k_ltb_obj_shape_gain_fixed
record.DESCRIPTION: LTB grows or shrinks an object's shape by multiplying the specified value with the object's dimensions once at the beginning of the prediction phase. Value greater than 1: object shape will be increased, value lower than 1: object shape will be decreased

record.NAME: k_ltb_obj_shape_gain_per_pred_step
record.DESCRIPTION: LTB grows or shrinks the ego shape by multiplying the specified value with the ego dimensions at every prediction step. This means, the more in the future a prediction step is, the more the shape will be grown or shrunk. This is in addition to the fixed gain specified by k_obj_shape_gain_fixed. Value greater than 1: object shape will grow, value lower than 1: object shape will shrink

record.NAME: k_ltb_critical_approach_min_safe_distance
record.DESCRIPTION: LTB considers an approach of an object to the ego with a distance smaller than the specified value as a collision.

record.NAME: k_ltb_critical_approach_angle_diff_min
record.DESCRIPTION: LTB considers an approach of an object to the ego only as critical above this angle difference.

record.NAME: k_ltb_alert_qualifying_cycles
record.DESCRIPTION: Number of cycle to qualify an alert level.

record.NAME: k_ltb_f_only_allow_consecutive_ttc_based_alert_levels
record.DESCRIPTION: Flag to only allow consecutive alerts. Applies to alert level 3.

record.NAME: k_ltb_f_skip_holding_for_single_alert_level_drop
record.DESCRIPTION: Flag to skip alert level holding if the drop is only to one level lower. Only affects drop from level 3.

record.NAME: k_ltb_alert_holding_cycles
record.DESCRIPTION: Number of cycle for holding an alert level.

record.NAME: k_ltb_alert_lvl_1_ttc_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: LTB raises an alert level 1 for an object with a calculated TTC smaller than or equal to the specified value.

record.NAME: k_ltb_alert_lvl_2_ttc_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: LTB raises an alert level 2 for an object with a calculated TTC smaller than or equal to the specified value.

record.NAME: k_ltb_alert_lvl_2_ttb_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: LTB raises an alert level 3 only for an object with a calculated TTB (time-to-brake) smaller than or equal to the specified value.

record.NAME: k_ltb_alert_lvl_3_ttc_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: LTB raises an alert level 3 for an object with a calculated TTC smaller than or equal to the specified value.

record.NAME: k_ltb_alert_lvl_3_decel_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: LTB raises an alert level 3 for an object with an estimated host deceleration to avoid a collision greater than or equal to the specified value.

record.NAME: k_ltb_brake_deceleration_max
record.DESCRIPTION: LTB caps the maximum braking deceleration to this value.

record.NAME: k_ltb_brake_dead_time
record.DESCRIPTION: LTB assumes that the vehicle will start deceleration after the specified dead time of the braking system.

record.NAME: k_f_ltb_enable_brake_gradient_logic
record.DESCRIPTION: LTB considers the brake gradient or jerk if this flag is enabled. It uses the value from k_ltb_brake_gradient.

record.NAME: k_ltb_brake_gradient
record.DESCRIPTION: LTB assumes that the vehicle deceleration will ramp up with the specified gradient or jerk. Only active if k_f_ltb_enable_brake_gradient_logic is enabled.

record.NAME: k_ltb_object_long_vel_min
record.DESCRIPTION: The minimum longitudinal target object velocity.

record.NAME: k_ltb_bmw_sp25_v_ego_max
record.DESCRIPTION: The max host speed below which ltb would be activated.

record.NAME: k_ltb_bmw_sp25_v_ego_max_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: The speed hystereses for ltb activation or deactivation.
